t: I suppose you have questions… That haven't been answered yet. So... who am I to you? This version of me, I mean. Well, I remember how we went to Ferris, how Tungars captured me... I remember our meeting at the Death Plant. I'm the same Elena as my... original copy. But there's something else in my head... the Architects' information... the Sculptor's memories... I'm something different...

There you are... We just came from Jigran, and we're about to leave again... I suppose you have questions... That haven't been answered yet. So... who am I to you? This version of me, I mean. Well, I remember how we went to Ferris, how Tungars captured me... I remember our meeting at the Death Plant. I'm the same Elena as my... original copy. But there's something else in my head... the Architects' information... the Sculptor's memories... I'm something different...
You cannot access the secret Superdove project data. But you are allowed to admire its perfection.
This is a hologram of a fascinating project "Superdove George".
You know, I'm not sure I'll come back to life if I die. I don't know what will happen to my Spark which is essentially a copy of another Spark... I need to speak with the others here.

Yes, we decided to leave Jigran for now. You know, I'm not sure I'll come back to life if I die. I don't know what will happen to my Spark which is essentially a copy of another Spark...

This allod is becoming too dangerous! The threat to all living things comes from the south where Hirkalla's power over the army of the dead is fading away with each passing day... An old villain has risen in Sadrok, and it became the stage for his revenge on his adversaries.

I need to speak with Skrakan, Danas and the others.

h: Receive a Clot of Eternal Fire

t: Yes, of course. Just for you: all the tools you might need in a sturdy box. I'll sell it to you just for {cost}.
h: Yes, I need to buy tools for my trip. Do you have anything I could use?

t: You can find anything you need in my shop. Anything you might possibly need and more!
Hah, you managed to find me... A disastrous place, isn't it?

We've been looking for these creatures' nest for a long time. And here we are.

Yes, this allod is the heart of this devilry. I don't know what happened to Skrakan and Nezeb near the Astral Gate, but we have a chance to finish off the demons.

It's time for the final battle!

If you're ready, join me. We won't show the astral creatures any mercy!
h: What did you want to tell me?

t: Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Alright, it looks like it really is time...

Was it your buddy who scared the whole bunch of thugs to death? She’s one of a kind! I’d like to meet her!
Do you know about Feint the Greedy’s treasure that is said to have been buried on one of these allods? Right among the buried ships... scary, huh?

I’m not scared, either. Let’s hit it! First we’ll get the keys. As soon as you go on with the hyena, give me a wave, I’ve got poison gas for the case. Then we’ll unload the cannons, use the charges to destroy the barricades and knock the information and the key out from Musket!
Do you really think I would take money for souls that have ended their existence in some way?
Don't you worry, please. I'll let everyone go, of course.

A weird place... I'm not sure if it exists for real, or if it is a vision, a mirage. It is covered with thick woods and deep swamps. All sorts of creatures dwell there, both sentient and not. I've seen kikimoras, satyrs, even a talking fox! On top of that, the place is swarming with ghosts. They are mostly Kanians - they look alive, but they are not. They all serve the mistress of that land - spirit Ziva, half-bird, half-human.

It used to be a quiet place, and the mistress was very sweet. But recently I heard from other travelers that something terrible had happened there - either a romantic heartbreak, or a curse... I suggest you don't approach Iriy without holy water and charged cannons.

Secret labs... Any secret the Committee is trying to hide eventually comes out. Everybody knows our research program is having issues: something always explodes, or leaks, or just fails. But the more classified info, the more gossips that are spreading all around the Astral, deeper and deeper all the time. Now there's a reflection of the horrible rumors ever spoken about the lab: mad scientists, cultist spies, inhuman experiments, deadly machines and crippled test subjects, all the things that could ever be born by a sick imagination. So if you ever happen to come across a scientific laboratory behind iron gates and make up your mind to land - I hope you've got nerves of steel...
h: Ask about the reflection of Lab 731

t:
Oh... these questions of yours!

Be careful not to find yourself in front of an inquisitor for your curiosity, you know.

Ok, I'll whisper you what I know. Listen attentively and don't interrupt!

A sect of Arisen mages recently emerged in the Empire. They deny the divine nature of Nezeb, Skrakan and even Tensess! These arrogant heretics discard old teachings and worship, ahem, "elements".

They believe that all beings are governed by four elements: Fire, Water, Earth and Nature. Everything is made of these elements and everything will decompose into them. They will incinerate anyone who doesn't accept their doctrine.

They've made enemies not only with the Church of Light, but with the rest of the Empire, too! One day the fanatics managed to seize a ship and escaped to the Astral. Rumors were they settled on a distant allod.

If you find their refuge, get ready for a tough fight.

Hunting for treasures, are we? He-he... You won't find any there! All you'll find is sand, the scorching sun, the heat and scorpions nesting in the ruins.

A Historian friend of mine told me that there once was a huge observatory there, where June priests studied the movement of the sun and stars. But these days the observatory temple is nothing but ruins half-buried in the sand.

Quite recently the wormfaces returned to the Tlalkoa Ruins. They cleared some of the halls and fixed up the old war golems, and now they guard the ruins zealously against trespassers. From what I understood they are led by someone named Mirage, who seems to be in dire need of something hidden in these ruins. So dire that he won't hesitate to kill anyone who enters the old temple. I was lucky enough to escape with my wife, or my bones would have long been dried and polished by the hot desert sun...

Once, sailing deep in the astral, I happened to stumble onto an island of eternal winter. It is ruled by Yaver Artea, an Arisen gone mad who calls herself the Snow Queen. What a nasty broad she is, I'm telling you! It's a miracle I got out of there in one piece.

The Snow Queen's pastime of choice is kidnapping people and posing riddles to them. Those that give the wrong answer are turned to ice statues!

Fancy a human being unable to move or breathe or even close their eyes. For a year, two years, a decade... Arg, what a nightmare! No, such coldblooded torment must not go unpunished!

But getting to the Queen won't be easy. Freeze, the mad werebear shaman, is a loyal guardian of his Queen's peace. Rumor also has it that during the strongest snowstorms a huge bear named Cold appears on the island. As to whether that's true or not, I'll leave that up to you to find out!

Oh, that is a very interesting place. And a dangerous one, too!

The Land of a Thousand Wings is a pile of rocks and ancient buildings gone to seed ages ago. Three islands are interconnected via thin bridges that offer a breathtaking view. The Land of a Thousand Wings is only inhabited by creatures that can exist there and not risk dropping into the astral at any moment or breaking their necks on mountain sides. I'm talking about aviaks and harpies.

As I understand it, aviaks were the first to come to the Land of a Thousand Wings, while harpies invaded the island much later, leading to a massive battle. The upshot was that Koual the Stormbearer, the aviak leader, was able to tame the wild harpies. The Harpy Queen and he made peace, and now their races live in complete accord, helping one another in every way. In fact, something tells me there's more to the relationship between Koual and Olivia the Temptress than just politics...

But that's irrelevant. When I visited the allod a few times, I was always surprised by Koual's wisdom and agile mind. He even managed to tame a wild manticore living in the ruins of an old temple! But in recent years the aviaks have shut themselves off from the rest of the world, having accused the League and Empire of greed and folly, and vowed to make swift work of any who would risk coming to their land. I don't know what triggered such unexpected hatred towards other races, but maybe you could find out? If you really intend to go to the Land of a Thousand Wings, however, you had better prepare yourself for battle!
h: Ask about the Land of a Thousand Wings

t:
Fenia's Island? Huh, it's not an island, it's a disgrace! Our Kanian Fortress used to be there, in which those, what do you call them... fenimists, is it?... have settled! Or is it feminists? Anyway, bloody-minded women who have gotten it into their thick heads that they should be equal to men, and this has driven them to their wits end. Where is it writ that women are equal to men? A woman is a woman, her job is to give birth to children and keep the house, and a man's job is to protect her! All this talk of mancipation is fine for the Empire, but we are simple folk, and we don't clog our heads with thinking about mancipation. Anyway, our girls, Kanians and Elves, regularly run off to this Cloister....

I don't understand why they are so up in arms against men?! Anyway, listen further. Their leader is Fenia, a crazy witch who has declared herself the incarnation of a deity and the protector of women. She declared that all the evil in the world comes from men, and she decided to wage merciless war against us, men that is! And if that wasn't laughable enough, she found some numskulls that believed in her! Or to be more precise, it was laughable until all the men on the island died, and the parts of their bodies, well - the body parts that are important to men - were... You know what, I don't want to talk about that. I was there, I saw it all with my own eyes. What a nightmare... It was a miracle I survived!

Anyway, now there are no men in the Cloister. But there is, however, a gang of girls of all races who have become crazed without male attention, and who are ready to rip any man that might set foot on the island to shreds. It's a paradox - they hate men, but without men they grow wild. No, I'll never understand women. Especially the type of women that grab a sword for no reason and try to chop off your most valuable asset... Ahem. I was talking about your head, not what you were thinking!

Is there no end to what you know? Then again... why should you? Can't say that this isle is a famous one...

That's because it is not an island at all. Turtle Island is a giant turtle that eternally swims through the Astral. It is so enormous that a whole village lives on its back! Rather, lived...

You see... Have you heard of those bastards that worship demons? Two noblemen, the Zalesky brothers, started this foul worship. As soon as Aidenus got a whiff of it, they gathered their militia, loaded up the ship, and fled. And so their eyes saw the Turtle Island that slowly swam through the astral space. They moored their ship. Peasants saw the noble ship and kindly welcomed the renegades, who then murdered their hosts! Save for several hunters, who managed to escape into the Astral in a rickety boat, taking along with them a piece of meteorite ore. They are the ones who told me this story...

If these demon worshippers manage to tame the turtle, then we are all in trouble! Those bastards have not forgiven nor forgotten anything!

So you're curious, huh? No one ever believed me when I warned travelers that the Overlord was concealing something behind his weird performance, and now look what's happening! I'd had my chance to come down to the Jail. It's really scary, you know, though I didn't go there on purpose. We were following a familiar route, and then, just out of the blue, we spy land in our Visor! An undiscovered Astral Isle! I didn't give it much thought, turned the wheel and landed. Wanted to find out where it had come from. We got seized just as we docked. By who? By the Overlord's servants, of course! Jumped out on us, took aim, and that was that. They kicked us real hard, I couldn't unbend for a whole week after that. Threw us in Jail, only it wasn't a ward, but a kind of a lightning dome. We found a half-decayed body of a Xaddaganian Special Emissary Corps soldier! There were shreds of a Kanian uniform near him. Boy, were we scared! Should have kept out noses out of it, for sure, but it was too late. We weren't there for too long, though. They took us to the Commandant of the Jail, and he turned out to be a Wormface. He threw his piercing glance at me, screwed up his face, and gave an order to the guards, so they dragged us back to the ship. I took my chance to have a quick peep around, and you know what? There wasn't just one dome - it was a whole island of Domes! One Dome per prisoner, I suppose, and hardly any of them were empty! So we got kicked off the isle. My whole crew fell unconscious just as we got up on board, and never remembered a thing. They even laughed at me, and thought I was kidding. Well, I wasn't! I think it was Wormface who erased my friends' memory, but it failed on me. I remember the Jail, and the prisoners, and the Demons. I am sure that it's how the Overlord gets rid of those who makes a stand against him. So beware, they won't be too soft with you. There's no human, there's no problem!

I don't know much about the jungle of Mboa-Mboa. We once traveled really far, into the deepest layers of the astral, and were just about to turn back, as we noticed a land on the horizon. We went closer and were blown away by the beauty! It was all green, bloom and blossom, butterflies fluttered about, monkeys jumped from tree to tree... It was paradise! At least, it had seemed to be until we set foot on dry land. But there - good gracious! I have never seen such hungry beasts! Enormous snakes, crocodiles the size of canoes, giant bloodsucking mosquitos. Did we turn on our heels! In our fright we ran right into a settlement of aborigines. They almost had us chopped to pieces, little evil bastards!

As soon as we escaped them, we stumbled into Draconids. They decided to invite us to dinner... to be dished up as a main course! So, we ran back twice as fast! We jumped on the ship and set off immediately...

I'm not setting a foot on that island again! To hell with such cruises!
h: Ask about the jungles of Mboa-Mboa

t:
That isle is not particularly noteworthy. I don't even know much about it. Seems to be a Kanian allod. Dobrinya Velikov, a mage-conjurer, rules it. He calls himself "Great", although I have my doubts as to his ability to maintain a grip on the isle. Not a pleasant fellow by any stretch of the imagination... Huffs and puffs as if he were truly great, while in reality he's nothing more than a county fair magician!
There was a rumor that long ago a young magician named Alla miraculously ended up on the isle without any ship. Seems like some magical twister picked up her house, along with her dog and a nail file...
On the island, Alla met strange but friendly creatures: a talking lion, an ancient lumberjack golem and a reanimated scarecrow. Together with her new friends, Alla found herself at the center of incredible adventures. In the end, she found the local mage who sent the would-be sorceress back home. Though if you ask me, I'd wager that the cause of this adventure was a bottle of fortified liquor, her huge impressionability, as well as a thirst for sensationalism among gum-beating scribblers, not a twister!

Duck River Run? Yes, I know, I know this place. A very small island, nothing out of the ordinary. There is a Kanian village on it, where I used to replenish my supplies. Salted duck, smoked duck, duck jerky... What did you expect? The whole village survives on waterfowl business! Good people. Kind and friendly. They always welcomed our ship. So if you're ever flying by, pay them a visit, you won't regret it.
Then again, I recently heard that some bandits attacked that village. It seems that some Imperial Orcs formed a gang and raided the village. But I find that hard to believe. Think about it, where did those bandits get a ship? Perhaps it is a lie...
h: Ask about the Duck River Run

t:
Blood Countess... Bathing in the blood of young girls to retain her own beauty... Do you really want to hear this story? Frankly speaking, it's disgusting.
Blood Countess' real name is Yasskul Bathory. A friend of mine, Fedor Stablemanov, knew her personally and told me that she was a nice lady and a prominent researcher. But her appearance was a fad with her. Bathory, once the most beautiful of the rulers, was grasping any chance to regain the lost beauty. And, unfortunately, she found a reliable way...
With the ancient dark magic she managed to rejuvenate her body... and lost her human soul!
For killing hundreds of girls she was outlawed and sentenced to death, but she managed to escape!
A whisper goes round that Blood Countess has hid on one of the astral islands. There she has a manor with many well-trained and loyal servants and continues her horrible and indecent actions. Beware of Blood Countess, if you do not want to be one of her slaves and end up in a bloodless body on the floor of her laboratory.

I heard about it. A funny story happened with this resort. As you know, those Imperial guys like to boast about their technology and play the role of nature tamers. That is why they wanted to build the resort on eternal ice. So they found an appropriate freezing islet, erected a dome and built a whole town underneath. Imagine... Icy wind is howling, but inside the dome birds are singing, green grass grows... Idyllic, so to speak.
However, those Imperial brainiacs did not account for the tribe of wild orcs that lived in the islet's caves. Those orcs mostly fed on mountain goats and mushrooms that grew there. And when Imperial engineers were building their dome, they cemented the underground stream. Due to a lack of pure water, goats died, mushrooms withered and orcs had nothing to feast upon. Naturally, they started warring with the resort guards. But those guards were ferocious in their own right! All veterans. Perhaps they thought that some bigwigs were going skiing or something. Made the resort secretive. One step beyond the perimeter and they would fire without warning. They don't care if you are a Kanian, Xadaganian or the Holy Tenses himself. They'll kill you on the spot!

Seasons... It has been so long since we last saw them change, even before Sarnaut broke... There's an old tale that tells about a little girl that was kicked out of the house into a deep forest in the middle of winter by an evil step-mother. She was about to freeze to death, when she came across twelve brothers on a clearing in the woods. These were the twelve months, who used to gather together once a year to see each other and chat. She warmed up by their fire and saw quite a few miracles.

That's merely a tale, of course, but one of my friends once told me he saw a wonderful isle in the Astral. It looked like a glass sphere, with a wood in the snow, and a clearing, and a fire, and twelve young men inside. As he flew by, the snow melted, flowers bloomed, then the green faded and withered, leaves began to fall, and then it was winter and snow again. He tried to approach the isle, but it disappeared all of a sudden, and he could never see it again. Do you think the tale told the truth? Is there such a place? Are there still seasons and the months? Who knows...
h: Ask about the Twelve Brothers' Grove

t:
This is an ancient stronghold, it traces its history back into the past. It started with the cordon lines built here by the Kanians to protect against orcish raids long time ago. It has seen many sieges, was burnt to the ground, but rebuilt every time... When the World broke into pieces, the shard of the stronghold disappeared in the Astral, but a bit of it remained.
Demon Hunters discovered and restored it, so it has become one of the strongest keeps. Demons don't even dare to approach!

You know about Quiet Hills, don't you? There was such a wonderful place... Until the ancient evil awoke there and gruesomely killed all the peasants. These peasants then roamed as ghosts, until brave heroes put an end to their suffering.
Quiet Hills have a reflection in the deep layers of the Astral. And it is far more fearsome than those horrors! An Imperial necromancer reigns there... He is so cruel that any damnation is a lesser evil than that bastard. That monster turned all good people into cursed undead! And nowadays Quiet Hills mean only a stench of death and undead skeletons. Those hills are no longer Quiet, but Dead!

New adventurers know that where there are June ruins, there are treasures. Wise adventurers know that treasures usually mean trouble. However, the wisest have been to all these ruins and took care of both.
Is there anything left in Altan Tepek? I have no idea. Never been there. One of my friends came across the isle but couldn't land there. He just flew around it and took a good look at it: it looks like a tropical forest, but it's frozen and covered in snow, and the wind rages through the place. Something seemed to move, but he wasn't sure what it was. Are you curious? Well, if you manage to land there, let me know what that was and why it's frozen!

Normally you can come across nobody but Demons in the Astral, but some time ago huge swarms of termites came from nowhere, invulnerable to the Astral or anything else. At first they attacked ships, and once they even made it to Nezebgrad!
One of the Free Traders entrapped a few, dissected their bodies and found meteorite dust inside. The smell of money made many sign on to find their nest. Alas, they found nothing but death. And can you imagine the size of their nest? Whatever riches they have in their stomachs, there is no way I’m coming near it.

You ought to know what happened in Irdrich. A powerful Zem necromancer, Tep, announced himself a god, and was about to put his foot on Sarnaut's neck with his army of mechanoids. The League and the Empire united their forces to crush him, and so they did. The remnants of Tep's army are still there in Sarnaut.
The rusty mechanoids either aren't aware of Tep's fall or turned away from him. So don't be surprised if you ever come across them in the depths of the Astral.

There are so many League resorts in the world! All kinds of them! Sea resorts, spa resorts, wildlife, sightseeing. Choose whatever you want. But no! Some prefer hot and forbidden pleasures!
So, there's this goblin, who set up a fight arena on one of the isles. Very much like Demonic Arena, only without demons. There's gambling, and drinking, and party girls, and smugglers, and assassins, and slave dealers... Shame. If you ever come across this isle, just turn your back on it. It's no good anyway.

Old Loam? Sure, I know it. A quiet village on a far away isle. It's interesting you're asking about it now. You must be sensing there's something wicked going on in the world?

One sailor told me the other day that the villagers were complaining about strange things happening in the nearby forest. First the animals went frantic, and then disappeared. Later they came back, but they were different, all quiet and odd. And then people started going missing!

You know, it all reminds me of another thing... There was that allod, small and sparsely populated as well, where the Empire scientists conducted their experiments. The Council folks! They observed Kanian everyday life. Studied our traditions and rituals to make it easier to spy on us!

Listen, if you have some spare time, will you find out what is going on there? We cannot leave it like that.

That's one interesting place. I haven't been there for a while... And I don't miss it.

Just several years ago Triplefield was a lively trading town. They sold all kinds of goods there - elven gems, peasant straw shoes, Kanian armor...

But then there was an outbreak of the undead - they exterminated the whole place, and very few managed to survive. They collapsed the single bridge that led to the town and settled in a small village, far away from the damned ruins.

Happily, the nearby elven enclave wasn't affected by the outbreak, and they helped the survivors put their life back on track. But still the former glory of Triplefield was gone for good.

I heard that the our Church had sent a squad of Inquisitors there, and now I am wondering what do those servants of the Light have to do with that Light-forsaken place?

Fire and ice, blinding flames and unbearable frost! Sounds beautiful, doesn't it? This is what Firefrost is. Once a magnificent temple was built on it. Now it's all ruins, and nothing good ever hides in temple ruins. This place is not an exception. It is swarming with wild goblins, trolls, cyclops, and hordes of Elementals. These guys are definitely not friendly. Also, they say there's a dreadful creature who mastered two Elements at once among them! How do you like that?

If you are ever around that place, don't forget to take a look at its beauty, and then turn your ship and fly for your life. Otherwise you will get right into the volcano eruption. You don't want to know how it feels like, believe me.

Sometimes the Astral amazes us with its beauty. The Tusky Lagoon is one of its most splendid wonders. A tiny isle with the sky of all imaginable colors. You need to see it for yourself.

Once only Aviaks used to live on the allod. A proud tribe who did not really welcome strangers. But they still let us in! Then one day they were attacked by pirates, who probably wanted to hunt June treasures in the local ruins. But the Aviaks fought back and robbed the pirates instead. They found some eggs in the hold and decided to keep them. That was a wrong thing to do.

Those were lizard eggs. Lizards are dexterous and hardy creatures, and they grow very fast. In the blink of an eye there was another tribe on the allod, a scaly one. The two tribes have been constantly fighting ever since.

The "wingless" are not allowed to enter the allod anymore. The Aviaks are unyielding. "Evil can't cure evil," - they say.

Don't you know about it? "East Overshoe - that's where we're going," traders used to say before sailing out to that trading city. Its citizens used to always talk in proverbs!

Once it was a rich and peaceful city. But you know, words have power. Every time they saw an arriving trader, they said: "Speak of the devil!" Naturally, one day a real devil's imp appeared. Now they are facing the music, so to say.

I flew by East Overshoe the other day - it's silent and empty. But who knows what's really going on there? Still waters run deep, they say!

Plaque City? Alright, I will tell you its sad story. They say, once it was a beautiful town, and the citizens lived in peace and prosperity. The trade was thriving, and the craftsmen were making good money, and everybody praised the Light and led a godly life.

Blissful places like that one are rare, and they are like thorns in the flesh of the evil. And so the trouble came. The city was stricken by a magical pestilence.

A mighty necromancer killed the city rulers and released all sorts of terrible diseases. The sky went black, and the earth swelled with impurity! Some citizens tried to burn the pest, but others seized the moment and descended to pillage.

Eventually, the curse got so strong that the city split away from the allod and dissolved in the Astral, and its name was erased from the memory of people. But sometimes it appears here and there to relive the terrible Day of Pestilence.

Be careful, or the city will swallow you as well.

Forgotten Temple? What, may I ask, is it you are looking for in that cursed place? Believe me, anyone who comes there craves to forget it has ever happened to them.

It used to be just plain June ruins in the middle of an island which was of no interest even to Demons, but then Wormfaces laid their hands on the temple and kindled a fire which had been dormant for centuries inside of it. The island burned like a torch until it collapsed with an ice shard of another allod. Now half of the island is burning with scorching fire, and the other one is ice-cold. Also, it is swarming with aggressive Elementals, golem sentries and Wormfaces, who detest strangers.

However, there are some madmen among the Historians who wish to risk their lives for the sake of science. I heard an expedition, lead by Martine de Blizare, recently set out to the Forgotten Temple... No one has heard anything from them ever since!

Ravine of Shadows? Yes, I've heard of it, although I haven't been there myself. One Priden traveler told me that many years ago a shard of Howlem split off and drifted away, with a temple which stood upon it.

Then some Astral pirates told me about a huge piece of rock in the Astral with ancient ruins on the top of it. They thought they could stuff their treasuries in that place, but they ended up fighting their own shadows! Few of them escaped, and the curse is still haunting anyone who dares to come to the Ravine...

I heard this story about the place: a long time ago, on a far away island, there lived a powerful mage who loved to conduct various experiments. One day he created a crystal - an artifact of unprecedented power which allowed him to control attractive force and alter matter. But as it turned out, the crystal had a mind of its own.

People in the city next to the tower started falling ill and dying, and the sorcerer himself became more cruel and reclusive. He stayed in his tower and barely interacted with the residents. At some point he noticed that the crystal never left his hands, and that he reacted badly when someone got curious about it. The mage realized that the artifact was changing him.

He decided to destroy the crystal, but it did not work, because he continued to hear the call of the artifact. The mage then decided to hide the fragments at a great distance from each other in hopes of weakening the artifact so he could control it. He created three shrines where he buried the pieces of the crystal. After taking the largest fragment of the artifact, the mage locked himself in the tower. He thought he could find a way to destroy the crystal completely.

Exhausted and embittered residents blamed the mage. They decided to destroy him along with his tower but could not finish the job. Over time, the island became deserted. The city was reduced to swampy ruins, and the shrines holding the artifact fragments developed cracks and partially collapsed. They changed the minds of the forest dwellers, making them more aggressive. Wights, zombies and skeletons appeared in the cemetery. And it got suspiciously quiet in the city square, among the destroyed statues and buildings...

They say a trio of treasure seekers recently went there - a family of Gibberlings: Indy, Nathan, and Lara... Perhaps you'll meet them?

Dersaadet... This is a unique place in the universe. Do you know that not all of the Xadaganians support Yasker and the Empire? There are people in the far away lands. They live up to their ancestors' legacy, like they did a century or ten centuries ago.

Dersaadet doesn't recognize the Imperial power. They deny the Trinity Church, but instead, they pray to the Almighty. Their language is unusual and their laws are strict. Mustafa al Muhad is the wise sultan of Dersaadet. His daughter is said to be the most beautiful young lady in the world. However, a stranger may never see her. She is immured in a high tower, called Maiden's tower.

There's no saying, the city is beautiful and most unusual, as well as its citizens. You should be aware, that if you ever come visit Dersaadet with peace, you will be welcomed, wined and dined, but if you dare to confront sultan's will, you will face his loyal janissary.

What would like to know?

These islands are for heroes who are ready to travel to the Holy Land but not yet ready to explore Irdrich.

(For players of levels 23 - 51)
h: Find out about nearby islands in the explored astral plane

t:
What would like to know?

These islands are for heroes who are ready to travel to Irdrich but who have not reached the maximum level yet.

(For players of levels 51 and above)
h: Ask about faraway allods in the explored astral
Ask about the allods in the Mysterious Astral

t:
What would like to know?

These islands are for heroes who are ready for the most difficult adventures with a Hero's Compass.
h: Ask about heroic adventures in the Mysterious Astral

t:
Greetings!

Do you want to learn more about astral allods and dangerous adventures? Listen to me then. Who knows, maybe this information will save your life.

This allod is rather small and ordinary. Seven old Knights used to dwell there, together with a poverty struck Elven House, who escaped from Anna’s harassment. Years passed by, but then the ill fate got them: first the Leper corrupted the island, then the leader of the House brought a present to his wife, who, by the way, originally went from Kania. The present was an antique June mirror, a plate of black obsidian in a golden frame, a true beauty. However, it’s typical for the June treasure to bear dark surprises. To cut a long story short, the allod used to be quite unnoticeable before, and now it’s also scary as hell. But who knows, may be some hot shots find themselves brave enough to obtain the rare treasure!

Nawlad Jeer is a living legend. Although "living" doesn’t quite describe him. He’s one of the world’s greatest necromancers. He’s been dwelling in an isolated mansion for many years now, talking only to the undead. His villagers, on the other hand, are quite the opposite: cheerful, merry, always willing to talk. Very open for vendors and foreign goods! One of my friends, a merchant, has recently been there, and just as he started unloading his goods, he saw a crowd of people staring into one spot, not paying attention to anything else. And there was this fog, ghostly fog spreading around. He made it to flee, scared to death. If you are ever around, may be, you will have a chance to find out what that was.

This allod belongs to Nomarkh Iblis, a rich inventor. He’s famous, but not too much respected - he prefers working out fraudulent plots to developing new weapons. The last time he played his trick on Yasker himself, but the latter couldn’t swallow that, of course, and sent a whole squad of Imperial soldiers to Iblis’ allod. I have no idea how it all will end, but my guess is that the Imperials don’t have much of a chance. The allod is well guarded and armed. We can go and watch the show. Want to bet that the Imperials will lose?

Another Imperial lab failed. They learn no lessons... The Dead City revealed some technologies, that were gathered and moved for testing to this very allod. They wanted to open some Gates, don’t ask me what that is, I don’t want to know. You’re asking why? Because all staff was urgently evacuated from the allod recently, the whole sector closed and isolated, entrance prohibited! Do you still want to sniff out the Imperial secret? Sure, you can, why not. Tell me what you’ll have seen there, alright?

This prosperous mine used to belong to Umoir traders. In fact, it’s Mistress who rules the allod, within and without. It’s her good will to share the riches. Evidently, people got her angry with their greed or disrespect. In any case, there are wild beasts now, where the settlement used to be. I’m too scared of the Mistress, so I wouldn’t go there myself!

This allod had always been nothing but a piece of rock, no life, no plants. But recently it magically transformed into a flourishing land with rivers, trees, and even a handful of houses! I docked and discovered amazing creatures I had never seen before. They look a little bit like Gibberlings, but fluffy and big-eared. They are quite friendly, if a bit twitchy. They say there’s another tribe beyond the mountain, and they are afraid of it. I wished that the Light would keep them safe, but they gave me a strange look and sent me on my way. That place is an enigma!

This is the most widely known pirates’ nest in the world! It attracts all kinds of scum from all over the universe! Feint the Greedy himself moved there before he died. People say, that’s where he buried his treasures. But it’s the old story. The news are more troubling, however. One of my acquaintances, a decent gentleman, was about to stop by and push off his, so to say, goods, and all he saw was a wrecked fort, plumes of smoke and purple tentacles over it. So there is nothing good about the place, I tell you.

I’ve been there. It’s a nice place: green forests, fresh springs. A settlement in the middle with a tall wall around it, a temple in its center and nice citizens. Good place to visit and trade, you know. The locals suffer from the thieves, but they’re rich enough to hire someone to deal with them, right?
What can I buy cheap and sell expensive?

Not at all. We are lucky to have stayed alive. I've never seen time freeze before!

I heard the sounds of battle somewhere near - it looks like some of the Hunters are still alive. We need to break through to them! I don't know who those Architects are, but they are going to regret coming here in the first place!
Are you alright? Can you walk?
Lower your weapon, hero. I am not a threat to you. I’m here to discuss an important matter.
Tell your guild leader I would like to meet them.
h: Sculptor’s ship? Why is it here and what does he want?
I’m a guild officer. The Sculptor wishes to see me, let me through.

t: No, I can't do that yet...
They gave me a book: secrets, codes, passwords, playthroughs. So I'm standing here and reading it now!

quests: Scientific Problem: Robobeasts of the Dome

t:
Catherina's ship is magnificent! I didn't think I'd ever set foot on it...

I have to say, we owe this to you for the most part, ! You are Sarnaut's hero. A rock that tumbled an avalanche of events.

Catherina's ship is magnificent! I didn't think I'd ever set foot on it...

I have to say, we owe this to you for the most part, ! You are the Hero of Sarnaut. A rock that tumbled an avalanche of events. It all started 10 years ago.

On this day, I remember those who are no longer with us. Things we lost. So many lives! Allods like Andis, Groh, Kech, Ovus, Scarge do not exist anymore!

We must preserve what's left of our world no matter what.

These days, I'd rather not scare you with another threat that you'll doubtless have to deal with soon, . Instead, we should remember something that has already been done...

Our world has changed significantly over the past few years! We have learned a lot that used to be unknown. We understand much more now. Too much knowledge is a dangerous thing, they say. But there's one thing I know for certain: with your help, we can overcome anything. Allow me to congratulate you on behalf of the Conclave of the League, even though my colleagues, Great Mages, are absent from this event.

So, on behalf of the Great Mage Bogshi from Forox, Great Mage Demid from Malar, Great Mage Silverst from Ellanesh, Great Mage Erophy from Zlatovest, Great Mage Kondrat from Anga, Great Mage Thaddeus from Tumagor, and all other Great Mages of small allods of the League - happy anniversary, !

Oh, a lot has changed over the years we've known each other, . When you just started your journey, the League and the Empire were fighting an inexpiable war, and our world was under the threat of demonic attack - and we didn't even know the scale of this threat...

But you have done so much, and our eyes are open now: we made peace with the Empire, ended the war with the treacherous gods, overthrew Tep, and repelled the attack of the Architects. Even Nihaz, while not completely defeated, is finally locked in his Citadel. And our new "Gates" project will allow us to reach other worlds and find new allies.

So our alliance - of the League and the Empire - will become even bigger. New nations will join it - nations we have yet to meet!

You?!

You shouldn't be here! After everything you've done - how dare you! Do you know how it all ended?

We are ruled by the Darkness now! It was foretold that you would defeat it, not help it subjugate all of Sarnaut!

I'm extremely disappointed that you did this to Klavdia.

You again...

What do you want me to tell you? We are guests at someone else's celebration, puppets of Hirkalla, the new mistress. Now all the Great Mages are her servants, forced to give their powers to her for the purpose of resurrecting the inhabitants of Sarnaut...

Yes, hello! Fifteen years have passed since your first exploits. Your fame has spread throughout Sarnaut. The Conclave of all the Great Mages spent hours discussing your person - and believe me, we made Hirkalla and Alisa recount everything they knew.

So, who are you? Many believe you were touched by some unknown force which made you the straw that broke the camel's back. It's Chance. That is, some element of unpredictability that upset the balance set by what the Gibberlings call Fate. Sounds complicated?

But these forces are more abstractions rather than individuals with their own interests. Although there is another approach...

Well, the problem requires further study... And you are an excellent material for observation!

Ah, young wolf... You smell and look weird!

Itkan told me that you a true hunter. Can you prove it?

Knowing how to hunt doesn't mean being a hunter. Do you know the Forest Law? Do you understand the Word of Blood? Tell me, cub, why shouldn't I just kill you and feast on your blood and flesh?

Scar declared you his prey. We wolves are not afraid of the tiger, but you are not of our blood. Tell me, cub, are you a hunter or a prey?
h: Prove that you are a true hunter

t: Well... The Pack is ready to speak its word!
h: Say that Mirrah, Belly and Boa are ready to speak a word in your favor

t: Hurry up, cub! The Big Hunt begins!
It was a glorious hunt on Isa! We are happy to get back to the old land... Howlem, Isa, and Ferris were once united as one. I'm sure those times will return now...
We serve the Endless Time. Overlord Nihaz said nothing about keeping you here.
h: Why aren't you attacking? You're Nihaz's servants, aren't you?

t: The Star Trail is full of strangers that cannot enter the world of All-Mother. But you may pass.

r507745.s: Great Mage of House de Grandeur

t: I'm here on behalf of the House de Grandeur!

, it's great the Eclipse is sailing around Umoir! I've always wanted to visit it.

No, don't think I'm impressed by all this technomagic. To me, it's some kind of... perversion.

I'm willing to accept the Galleon Castle, but this ship... alright, it has its charm, I admit, but... I wouldn't want us to commit to this path where we build things like that.

But let's not talk about that! This is your celebration!
May the lucky star always shine upon your home! Would you like some fresh fruit or lovely sweets? I can give anything to the one who saved us!

I don't know much, travelers. I was selling sweets and spices under the city wall, when Rustem Aga brought Janizary, may his name be cursed forever. They turned my tables upside down, kicked my back, ruined my goods... They blamed me of poisoning. Lord forbid, how could I be a poisoner? I never did any such thing!

I have no idea! The only thing I know that a servant of the Grand Vizir ordered a basket of fresh purple pomegranates - a very rare and delicious fruit. He mentioned that the fruit was meant for Guzel, the charming Sultan's daughter. Vizir's maid picked up the basket in the afternoon, and the next morning Janizary came.

It turns out, that if I pick the fruit, I am the poisoner? I am under suspicion? Woe to me! I've been dishonored!
h: Ask about the reason for accusations

t:
I do not enjoy balls!

However, I must thank you -

since I have regained my destiny,

I have accepted a government position.

Having stopped senseless disputes,

I have been using my skills for the benefit of others

 - in that great mixture of peoples, eras and countries,

 which was created by a certain event,

I look for the original genealogies of the Awakened,

so I can learn about their origins...

And there is no end to this work!

We've reconciled with Sofia. In the evenings we read books.

And I listen to my father-in-law, keeping silent.

I don't argue with him, because he's an old man,

and he won't change his ways no matter what!

I have a few guys that can crash skulls or support you in combat. It's up to you to give them a task. I owe Wienna, so my people are at your service.

Here's Warl called the Tormentor. I don't think his specialty requires an explanation... When this guy is on the night watch, even crickets find it best to shut up.

Kaya. A killer. She spills so much of her enemies’ blood that the ground is stained red for weeks. She charges twice as much just for the pretty face.

Trip... funny name, isn’t it? Not a bad one for a goblin shaman. He’s a decent healer, though his methods are... Questionable. If he starts talking about a giant pigeon - ignore him. Those mushrooms of his can produce stranger visions.

It's not the Astral itself that's dangerous, but rather the high probability of encountering demons or pirates eager to appropriate your ship's cargo. So if you don't want to get one in the stern or take a trip to the purgatory, listen to me very carefully.
The safest place to be for you is always the capital's allod. There you are protected by astral howitzers, which are state-of-the-art technology! Those guns can blow any enemy ship to bits with a single salvo.
The rest of the sector where your capital's allod is located is relatively safe, too. In fact, the home sector is a good reference point for the ship's navigation system. Upon sustaining critical damage, the ship will simply jump to the hangar without sustaining any losses. However, nobody is safe from boarding, the pirates' favorite tactics...
By the way, in any other sector the emergency jump will be done blindly when the ship faces a lethal threat. All cargo will be dropped into the Astral and the hull will sustain severe damage. However, the chests can be loaded back on board if you return to the site of battle... That is, if the pirates don't get there first.
And remember, no emergency jump is going to save you if the ship's reactor explodes or if you get too deep into an unstable zone, as the ship will simply blow up.
 And if for some strange reason you happen to find yourself in the Kanian Archipelagos, the League capital's allod, you can forget about emergency jumps altogether - a battle lost in a sector adjacent to the enemy allod will result in the ship's death. Remember, we're not the only ones with howitzers installed on our coast - the enemy has got them, too!
h: Ask about the dangers lurking in the Astral

t:
Glad to see you.
You know, the Astral is unstable, we are trying to predict the way it changes and put this information into the Pilot Chart, which enables crews to perform direct jumps between Astral sectors.

Astrolabe allows calculating long Astral jumps for quicker traveling.
While in the Astral, you have to activate the Astrolabe and select a sector. The Astrolabe will guide the ship to a point of interest: Astral isle or other important object. It won't spend the teleport charges, but you cannot aim the jump, so you will have to travel to your destination afterwards, and the Astrolabe will take some time before next use to recharge.
Remember, a jump may be interrupted by an incoming attack!
Good afternoon, soldier! We have only the best for the Empress's soldiers.
Nihaz is only a name. We serve the aspect of Destruction. Follow your path.
h: Why aren't you attacking? You're Nihaz's servants, aren't you?

t: Dragons are pursuing their goal. We served Father Time. We serve the one, who took His place. You may pass, mortals.

The task before us is extremely interesting!

Use necromancy to create an army of undead and throw it against this new kind of demon?

That’s genius! I think we are entirely ready to do that.

The only thing, or rather person, that worries me is Andrea and our other young companions... They are all irresponsible and careless, unable to really understand the very essence of the mission before us. I already said this to Zayan and Dakkar, and now I’m telling you – expect trouble from those “golden youths”!

Be careful – when I see Andrea, I feel like we’re one step away from a  problem!
h: What do you think happened here?

t: In studying the history, you find more questions than answers.
I feel something new... But first we should probably leave this place...
I knew we could handle him if we ever met again... The Great Summoner, pfft.
I'd rather not chat in this tomb. Let's get out of here first, then talk.
Tep! He's back... We made a terrible mistake when we freed his Spark... Now he's the lord of the Death Domain, the rightful ruler of Ganzir...

It was Tep! All this time... Tep was under Alyosha's guise...

He gained new powers... Remember how Nihaz wanted to get the powers of Sarn or the All-Mother? But he couldn't do it himself!

And Tep took my sister's divine power and mine - not all of it, or we wouldn't be talking right now, but it was enough for him to become the god of Death, the absolute ruler of this Domain.

We will see the consequences soon, everything will plunge into a nightmare. We must get through our disagreements. if joining forces with Hirkalla will help us survive, then so be it.
I think we have something to discuss...

quests: Problems of the City: Iaver Bazar's Cadavers
Good Deeds for the City: Missing Books
Reconciliation in the Face of a Threat
Reconciliation in the Face of a Threat

t: I SPECIFICALLY ASKED...! Oh, fine. Here, take this and run along. Deal?
For the love of... You think time travel is a joke? Here. Take this and go.
You again! Which "you" would that be? From what year?
You don't understand, do you? It's so hard to deal with clueless creatures like you! Take this thing and go!
Oh, I can't deal with this...
I'd tell you to step aside before you're crushed by that. Take this and leave.
Well, well, well... You are here again. Reminds me of that story with pineapples...
I'm calibrating, can't you see? There are so many temporal anomalies on Ferris after your adventures. It's going to take a while! Here, take this as a keepsake! Now off with you!
Oh ho ho! You're the last person I need here! It's been a while!
Calibrating is a delicate process. You already ripped the space-time continuum apart... I'll give you something, and you'll go away, alright?
I was hoping there'd be no prying eyes here!
I'm dealing with the consequences of someone's stupid decisions! Can't you see I shouldn't be disturbed right now? I'm going to give you something, and you will go away while you still can!
There's no escaping the noisy Hero of Sarnaut...

I wonder what makes you run around the world like this? Going somewhere you have no business being? This place is already too unstable and illusory! If you still don't understand - you are distracting me. Take this souvenir and go.
Don't tell me you come here everyday to watch the waterfall...

He who controls the future controls the past. He who controls the past conquers the future. It's time for me to play this game... Although that's none of your business. What should I give you to make you go away for good? Catch this.
There are so many prying eyes here, it's scary. It's good when you have time on your side.

Correcting mistakes. Yours included. Those you are making right now and the ones you are about to make. You don't understand now, but you will in time. The decision you made was wrong, so you must use any means to correct it!  But it's not the time yet. Here, take this piece and leave!
That's some kind of masochism, running around the place looking for something you have no business knowing about.

Didn't they teach you anything? Do you really think temporal anomalies just appear and disappear for no reason?

Do you have any idea how hard it is to configure a time jump?

...Oh, fine. I guess there's no other way to get rid of you, so here, take it. And stop bothering me!
The stranger appears to be intently focused on studying the portal...
Oh, hey! What are you doing here?

Well, well, well. What do we have here?

Are you having fun? Enjoying yourself? Great...

Only you can see me here. It's a nice perk. Don't forget my tasks, hero!

Well, well, well. What do we have here?

Are you having fun? Enjoying yourself? Great...

Only you can see me here. It's a nice perk. I see the list of guests has changed a bit. And we don't know what will happen next year...

Look at them. They smile at you, compliment you. A year from now they won't even shake your hand.

You can still change everything. The main thing is to take the right fork on the road of history. Make the choices you want. Discard the obvious and disregard the seemingly important.

I really want to help you all, but I can't do everything alone.

A year ago I told you that no one would shake your hand at the next Anniversary. And as you can see, I was right. However, the guest list has changed considerably, and now my sister's henchmen are running the show.

Rest assured, she will find the darkest of the souls in our world and place them at her service. She has already resurrected too many of those who were once a threat to all of us and who met their death at your hands.

Can we fight her? I'm sure we can. Although Aidenus and Yasker are extremely disappointed in you, I'm sure that in time they will understand that the hero of Sarnaut is the one who can rid our world of Hirkalla's influence.

In turn, I will try to find us new allies. In the present, in the past... and perhaps even in the future? Horizon is just a shadow of existence, an unfulfilled reality, but… it's still a reality! Nihaz created that version of the future where we had people who could oppose his darkness. Perhaps this is his weak spot.
Darkness is only a part of existence. It never had all the answers.

h: Send me back to the Sanctuary

t: First of all, you need to show my Children that you have learned your lessons, because they need to believe that you are not one of Nihaz's minions.
h: Why can't I take the exam here?

t: Is there any hope for me, child? I knew Nihaz was cunning, but I underestimated him... Sarnaut was a prison for a god, but for me it became a trap... From which there is no way out... unless my divine children are summoned...
h: You are not alone in this world... There is hope.

t: There is only Darkness all around… Was this my Fate?

Run...

No!

I have to wait, otherwise... why?!

What do you mean? I’m helping Dakkar and Zayan, of course!

Prince Dakkar himself! His necromancy abilities are beyond anything you can imagine! Ah, my savior...

If you want to know how I passed ten years since my uncle died and I was forced to survive on the island where we met the prince... I learned a lot! Yes, yes, I went to the academy in Nocturn, enrolled in courses and buried myself in books. This adventure of ours now will be my dissertation!

As for my friends from the Mysterious Island, we often get together and reminisce about what happened.
h: Hi, what are you doing here?

t: I must be worthy of my uncle’s legacy!
You're right. We better get going.
Strange things happen here, friend. The secrets of Time Void are inexhaustible indeed.
By Gods... it happened! I had it all...! He was a student... An elf... His name was Gastosh... He had a black beard... And wore leather boots...! And he loved me so much... He loved me so much!

What a brilliant idea!
My throat is quite dry. So many people have listened to my sermons, but many have yet to hear them so I must keep talking!
A drink is just what I need.
h: Give them a glass of porter

t: I had a lot of debts, and my father eventually refused to pay them – what was I to do? Join the army, of course. And of course, anything could happen here: I could get wounded, Tensess forbid; I could lose a leg, I could even get killed, but there was no other way out. And when I get back, I'll go live with my sister - her husband is rich...

If you are looking for wisdom in such a dark time, let me give you some advice:

When choosing between two evils, listen to your heart - it will not make a mistake. Our minds wander, but our hearts know what should be done.

quests: Catch the Winds of Luck Again

t: Awakened from a century-old sleep, we are forced to obey the one who holds the bonds that tore us from peace.
Greetings, Stormbringer! Apios told me all about you.

The tribe of warriors... Perfect.

Citovras taught us to search other tribes of warriors and learn their wisdom.

Alice was reportedly spotted not far from here... But what does it matter? I know the empress wants her captured, but who can catch that one? She is a quick little girl, hopping through time like a squirrel on a pine branch.

I don't understand how someone's destiny can be stolen, ... Is there such a thing as destiny? If someone decided that I was destined to betray my friends and then die at their hands, would that mean it's not my fault?

Oh, well... We have enough lunatics around here... Recently some fool came to see his fiancée but had an argument with her father, caused a scandal, was close to throwing himself at the guests, then demanded a carriage and left...

Or another case - not in the city, but in a village nearby - some young merchant's wife cheated on her husband and, instead of keeping silent about it, she told everyone... Does that seem sane to you? They say her mother-in-law is making her life hell... I hope nothing bad happens...
h: What do you know about stolen destinies?

t: What a horse! Never seen such a stallion! How could Mira Hooves say goodbye to such a horse!
What's that? Why do I need it?
There were many... entering the tower... But before they died, they needed to see their faces... When was that? Who was I?
Yes, I remember this thing! Time to get going!
Why are you giving me this? I’m not a pretty dame who gazes into mirrors.
They thought they could break me with their hints. Hah! A true warrior fears no injury!
A cane? I’ll show you a good caning!
Thank you. Thank you so much... I'm glad I'm not forgotten. I've been here for ten years! It's time to find myself a replacement. I wish there were volunteers.
h: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

t:
Life goes on.

After you defeated Vakula, the werewolves elected a new leader. He never cared about the treaty, though. He said it wasn't fair.

So they stayed here. They don't attack anyone, at least. No one's going to hunt them down on foothills, in forests, and mountain caves.

The nobility is talking about rioting again. It's been ten years since the rioters were executed, their kids have grown.
h: What's going on out there? How are the werewolves doing?

t: Were we watching the werewolves? On the contrary, they were watching us.

We're all here to help Dakkar and Zayan.

Umoir wasn’t chosen for nothing. Look! These ruins carry traces of so many battles. There were so many dead, the land is literally seeded with corpses.

The city of Veligrad once stood here. It fell to the hordes of Tugarin the Giant, and its denizens were slain. And now we have no other option but to enlist their corpses to save this world!

I am extremely happy to see everyone Zayan gathered! Amanda is my best friend... But Alfred – he’s always grumbling. He nagged me back on Siveria and he's nagging me now. And he’s not even from our family!
h: Greetings! How are things? What are you doing here?

t: And I'm floating in a most peculiar way And the stars look very different today
Recommended by Comrade Rysina for joining this creative group.
h: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

t: Hah! You have a good eye. When you work for the City Council, this tiny discrepancy works out fine. Anything that allows to raise less suspicions. I can't tell you more. Even though you're a Sarnaut hero, sometimes ignorance truly is bliss.
h: You don't look like a Xadaganian to me.

t: I'm a screen and voice-over actor for Motion Stories at the Dream Factory. Bobbing and weaving, so to say. I can imitate the voice of almost any person in Sarnaut. It's just my hobby. I used to work for the City Council, so impersonations have come into habit. I can be all that someone else can be.
The name's Andrei Sokolov. Culture department officer.

quests: Equipment Upgrading Tutorial: Scroll of Enchantment
Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Guardian Ring of Al Rihat
Al Rihat Circle: Black Boar Meat

t: Hello, hello! I represent Nefer Ur and Scientific Council here. I observe and write up reports.
Light... it seems Light... is leaving this place! We are all doomed, because Tep's revenge will be inevitable... Sarnaut will become a mass grave!

Dear heroes! I, Andrey Lemkov, the governor of this city, need your help. I lived my life according to certain rules and beliefs. I was a supporter of traditional values and order. But everything changed when I met Julia, my wife.

Julia is a strong-willed and freedom-loving woman who changed my understanding of the world and society. Her determination and conviction in her ideals make me see the world differently, make me act boldly and decisively even if it contradicts my beliefs. Today I stand before you not only as a governor, but also as a husband who is afraid of disappointing his wife.
Hello there! How can I help you?
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!

quests: Kill 30 enemies in the Kingdom of Elements with your War Banner raised…
The Creator's Path: the Kingdom of Elements
The Creator's Trials: The Kingdom of Elements

t: The worthiest warriors roam this hall, but they lost themselves. In the chest next to me is something that will return memory and peace to each of them... Show me you can hear not only yourself, but others as well. Return peace to this worthy men.
h: What do I need to do?

t: I have long been indifferent to the deeds of the living and the dead, and I have learned both wisdom and power. I protect my home, but I am always glad to see worthy people here. You don’t look familiar, and I can't let you go further until you show me that you are wise and loyal.

Wonderful. You proved your wisdom and understood an important thing: whatever happens, you must remain a person of honor until the end. Do you still want to enter the halls of heroes? Once you decide, we will bid farewell to each other, and the wisdom you acquired here will stay with you until the end of time.
h: I put all three ghosts to rest.

t: You proved your right to do so.

I will tell you the story of this knight. Enemy hordes besieged Veligrad, and a commander named Kolyvan was defending the city. Some enemies got inside the walls. He greeted them and pointed each of them to a mirror. He thought it was fair that a person saw their face before they died.

I will tell you the story of this knight. He was the head of the city during the war against Leviathan and was captured by the enemy. Next day, they brought him a bear head on a dish. When he saw it, he realized what would happen to him if he didn't surrender. But they failed to break his spirit even when an axe was raised over his head!
h: I gave the bear head away

t:
I will tell you this man's story. Together with two friends - a great preacher and a noble man - he launched a campaign against the enemy that insulted their faith. On this journey, they saw many things: the preacher was delighted by miracles, believing them to be a proof of the existence of his deities; the noble man also saw a reflection of his god in all good deeds. The peasant followed them in silence, leaning on his stick.

Two months later, they reached the disputed lands and spent the night there.

In the morning they saw that the enemy surrounded them but was not in a hurry to attack - they were unsure whether they were friends or foes.

The preacher said, "Our god tricked us! The army is defeated, and we don't stand a chance!"

The noble man said, "It's over... But perhaps we can cross over to their side?"

The peasant said, "I'll die with my god."

He died soon after, pierced by dozens of swords.

The other two lived to a ripe old age.
